WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
), above_average AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.overall_avg_hgb AS above_overall
    FROM patient_averages p
    CROSS JOIN overall_average o
    WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_avg_hgb
), above_average_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS mean_avg_hgb
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT a.ID, a.avg_hgb, a.above_overall,
       a.avg_hgb - m.mean_avg_hgb AS difference_from_above_average_mean
FROM above_average a
CROSS JOIN above_average_mean m
ORDER BY difference_from_above_average_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
